title: Fullstack Software Engineer
shortDescription: Build end-to-end web applications using modern technologies and frameworks.
description: As a Fullstack Software Engineer at Mosaiq, you'll work on diverse projects from concept to deployment. You'll collaborate with designers and other engineers to create polished, user-friendly web applications. This role offers hands-on experience with the full software development lifecycle and the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
requirements: 18+ years of age
Strong foundation in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.)
Basic understanding of backend development (Node.js, Express, APIs)
Familiarity with version control (Git)
Self-motivated with strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment
niceToHave: Experience with TypeScript
Knowledge of database design (SQL or NoSQL)
Understanding of RESTful API design
Experience with deployment and DevOps (Docker, CI/CD)
Contributions to open-source projects
UI/UX design sensibility

title: UI Designer
shortDescription: Create beautiful, intuitive interfaces that delight users and bring our projects to life.
description: As a UI Designer at Mosaiq, you'll be responsible for crafting the visual language of our projects. You'll work closely with engineers to translate ideas into polished, user-friendly interfaces. From wireframes to final designs, you'll shape the look and feel of everything we build. This role is perfect for someone who loves pixels, color theory, and making digital experiences feel just right.
requirements: 18+ years of age
Strong portfolio demonstrating UI design work
Proficiency with design tools (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, etc.)
Understanding of design principles (typography, color, layout, hierarchy)
Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS
Ability to create responsive designs for multiple screen sizes
Strong communication skills to collaborate with engineers
niceToHave: Experience designing for web applications
Knowledge of design systems and component libraries
Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG)
Motion design or animation skills
Experience with prototyping tools
Front-end development experience
Illustration or graphic design skills

title: Research Scientist
shortDescription: Explore emerging technologies and innovative solutions to push the boundaries of what we build.
description: As a Research Scientist at Mosaiq, you'll investigate cutting-edge technologies, conduct experiments, and prototype novel solutions to challenging problems. You'll have the freedom to explore new ideas, test hypotheses, and bring research-backed insights to our projects. This role is ideal for someone who loves diving deep into technical problems, staying on the bleeding edge of technology, and turning research into practical applications.
requirements: 18+ years of age
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience with research methodologies and experimentation
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, JavaScript, etc.)
Ability to read and understand technical papers and documentation
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Self-directed with the ability to manage independent research projects
niceToHave: Background in computer science, data science, or related field
Experience with machine learning or AI
Knowledge of statistical analysis and data visualization
Familiarity with academic research and publication
Experience with prototyping and proof-of-concept development
Understanding of emerging web technologies (WebAssembly, WebGPU, etc.)
Contributions to research communities or open-source projects
